brief:
Unemployment and systematic targeting pose mounting threats to the future prospects of Palestinian youth, according to Ma'an Wire. Young Palestinians face compounding pressures from limited job opportunities and security operations that disrupt education and economic participation across the territory. The dual crises have deepened in recent months, leaving many unable to secure stable employment or complete their schooling.

The challenges undercut efforts to build sustainable livelihoods and professional development among a generation already navigating displacement, mobility restrictions, and economic hardship tied to the broader conflict. Rights advocates warn that without intervention, the deteriorating conditions risk pushing more youth toward informal work or leaving Palestinian areas entirely in search of opportunity elsewhere.
title: Unemployment and targeting threaten Palestinian youth futures.
